abilities.name: rain-dish
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

hoenn.flavorText: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It folds its wings to rest.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

updated-johto.flavorText: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

original-unova.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

updated-unova.flavorText: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

kalos.flavorText: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Wingull rides updrafts rising from the sea by extending its long and narrow wings to glide. This Pokémon’s long beak is useful for catching prey.

original-alola.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they’re circling, the ocean is sure to be teeming with fish Pokémon.

updated-alola.flavorText: It builds nests in cliffs by the sea. It circles the skies above the ocean looking for its favorite food—Wishiwashi.

swsh.flavorText: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.
